snippet.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Join Geralt of Rivia on the Path in the newly remastered edition of the genre-defining RPG. With improvements to visuals, gameplay, interface, and much more, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered is the definitive way to experience Geralt's legendary journey.

The Remastered update also includes the Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine expansions — and it is already available to players who own The Witcher 3 on GOG, Steam, Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5, and XBOX Series X|S.
